newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE telecommunications company Etisalat to start laying down an undersea cable which will link the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar.
- Tunisia plans to build 1,000 artificial lakes with a capacity of 50 million cubic metres of water.
- Iraqi central bank studies plans to create firms to trade in foreign currencies to fight the black market.
- Saudi businessmen to discuss in Moscow ways of boosting trade exchanges between the two countries during a three-day visit starting on February 16.
